Title: Security update for apache-commons-codec, apache-commons-io, apache-commons-logging, avalon-framework, avalon-logkit, glassfish-jsp, jsch, maven-file-management, opentest4j

Notes.Text: Security update for apache-commons-codec, apache-commons-io, apache-commons-logging, avalon-framework, avalon-logkit, glassfish-jsp, jsch, maven-file-management, opentest4j
Notes.Title: Topic

Notes.Text:
This update for apache-commons-codec, apache-commons-io, apache-commons-logging, avalon-framework, avalon-logkit, glassfish-jsp, jsch, maven-file-management, opentest4j fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-86231: improper check for certificate revocation when processing `known_hosts` entries (bsc#1279889).

Changes for apache-commons-codec:

- Updated to version 1.22.0.

Changes for apache-commons-io:

- Updated to version 2.22.0.

Changes for apache-commons-logging:

- Updated to version 1.4.0.

Changes for jsch:

- Updated to version 2.28.7.

Changes for maven-file-management:

- Updated to version 3.2.0.

Changes for opentest4j:

- Updated to version 1.3.0.

Vulnerabilities.Description: A security flaw has been discovered in mwiede jsch up to 2.28.5. Affected is the function getRevokedKeys of the file src/main/java/com/jcraft/jsch/KnownHosts.java. Performing a manipulation of the argument known_hosts results in improper check for certificate revocation. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The attack is considered to have high complexity. The exploitability is told to be difficult. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 2.28.6 is able to address this issue. The patch is named 194a2f76a5c0f1c3f778565be3fd66bcafc42d23. You should upgrade the affected component.
